title: 50agents vs Lindy: assistant or workspace | 50agents
description: Lindy is an AI assistant in Slack, iMessage and email, billed per user; 50agents builds AI agents, automations and apps for a workspace. Rows sourced.
answer: Pick Lindy if you want a personal AI assistant that lives in Slack, iMessage and email and can learn a task from one demonstration.
Pick 50agents if you want AI agents, fixed automations and small apps for a whole workspace, each built from plain words; it is free to start.
ask: Go through my unread email now, then every weekday at 8:00, and draft replies
lede: Both ask before anything with outside impact and both build from plain words; they differ in where you talk to them and how they bill.

us: A team shares the work, and per-user billing would multiply the cost.
You need fixed automations and an app, such as leads, requests or invoices, next to your AI agents.
You want to try it free before anyone on the team pays.
them: You want your assistant in iMessage, Slack and email, not in another app.
You prefer to show it a task once rather than describe it.
You need an app that is in Lindy's 2,733 and not in 50agents' 2,300+.

move.title: Copy each Lindy's instructions
move.body: We found no AI agent export on Lindy's pages, so copy each one's instructions, apps and schedule.

move.title: Turn them into asks
move.body: Write each as one sentence, such as the ask at the top of this page. Give it to Captain and connect Gmail when it asks.

move.title: Switch at the end of the cycle
move.body: Lindy's monthly credits do not roll over, so cancel just before renewal.

faqs.q: Is 50agents an AI assistant like Lindy?
faqs.a: Partly. You talk to Captain and to each AI agent in its own chat, but inside 50agents, not in iMessage or Slack.

faqs.q: Which is cheaper for a team of five?
faqs.a: Lindy bills each active user from $29.99 a month, so five people are five seats. 50agents is free to start, so the team can try it before anyone pays.
Yes. Lindy says anything with outside impact waits for your OK; in 50agents, sends to people outside wait in Needs you.
